시편 149:1.content: Praise ye the Lord. Sing unto the Lord a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.

시편 149:2.content: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

시편 149:3.content: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.

시편 149:4.content: For the Lord taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.

시편 149:5.content: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.

시편 149:6.content: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;

시편 149:7.content: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;

시편 149:8.content: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

시편 149:9.content: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the Lord.
